thread:
Ashley: Quick postmortem follow-up — noticed a repeating pattern across the last three outages: short auth token storms that cascade into model-registry timeouts and then increased error rates from the hosted models. We need a small, concrete mitigation plan with owners and timelines. :eyes:
Morgan: Agree. Can we capture the exact recurrence pattern? weekly/daily/time-of-day?
Jordi: From logs it looks like token refresh bursts around 03:00 UTC and again at ~15:30 UTC — correlates with third-party identity provider refresh windows.
Priya: That's the IdP patch rollout window for that vendor. They push rolling certs at top-of-hour. We should not rely on their pattern for our single point of auth.
Cal: Action idea: add a local token cache with jittered refresh and an emergency fallback service token for read-only model registry ops. Owner: @Cal. ETA: EOD +3 (POC).
Ashley: Good. Add synthetic probe that hits auth workflow + model-registry read endpoint and alerts on >5% latency increase in 5m. Owner: @Priya. ETA: 48h.
DevOps-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4112 (postmortem-followup) — assigned to SRE-Lead.
SRE-Lead: I'll take overall coordination. Suggest we break this into 3 items: 1) short-term mitigation (cache + fallback), 2) monitoring/alerting and runbook updates, 3) vendor engagement + SLA ask.
Morgan: +1. For (2) I'll own runbook updates and paging thresholds. ETA: 72h.
Jordi: For the cache POC, here's the quick curl to validate model-registry read fallback (use the service token):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_FALLBACK_TOKEN" https://model-registry.prod.internal/v1/models/health
```
Return: {"ok":true, "version":"x.y"} when healthy.
Priya: We should also add token-refresh jitter to the client SDKs (node + python). I'll open two PRs and tag devex. Owners: @Priya + @Morgan. ETA: 1 week.
Cal: Can we add an automated monthly dry-run where we simulate IdP latency by introducing 1s auth delays in staging and measure failure surface? Owner: @Cal. ETA: 2 weeks.
Ashley: Vendor ops: can someone lead the outreach to the IdP and request a change window / more predictable schedule? Also ask them for root cause details of their rolling certs. Owner: @Ashley. ETA: 72h.
SRE-Lead: I'll also rotate an on-call preflight check to verify all customers with dedicated/private deployments have local token caching enabled as per new config. Small checklist in the console. Owner: @SRE-Lead. ETA: 1 week.
Morgan: For tracking, I'm adding these as action items in the postmortem board: ACTION-172: cache-fallback-POC (Cal), ACTION-173: synthetic-probe (Priya), ACTION-174: runbook-update (Morgan), ACTION-175: idp-engagement (Ashley), ACTION-176: sdk-jitter-prs (Priya/Morgan), ACTION-177: staging-dryrun (Cal). I'll include explicit acceptance criteria for each.
Ashley: Acceptance criteria notes: cache POC must demonstrate <1% additional error surface during a 5m injected IdP delay; synthetic probe must fire pager when model-registry read latency >300ms for 5m; vendor engagement must include committed change window or SLA amendment.
Jordi: Also flag possible model-registry hardening: increase local retry backoff for registry reads and limit burst concurrency. Might shave off some failures before fallbacks. Owner: @Jordi. ETA: 5 days.
Priya: Will update the console docs with a short note about config knobs: `auth.cache_ttl`, `auth.refresh_jitter`, `registry.read_fallback_enabled` and link to runbook.
Cal: Quick sanity check: does dedicated infra already have any cache? I think some teams enabled per-service caching, but not centralized. We should inventory. Owner: @Cal. ETA: 72h.
SRE-Lead: Next sync: Thursday 09:00 UTC to validate progress. Please update ACTION tickets before then. If anyone hits blockers escalate in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
Ashley: Thanks all — let's keep updates short in this thread. Passing to owners to update their assigned actions. :handshake:
